answer: Require each agent to earn a scarce, non-transferable participation credential by completing a small task whose result is checked against a randomly assigned challenge. The credential can be reused across interactions, but cannot be copied to create more identities; challenges rotate so one solved task does not unlock a batch. A sybil operator must therefore pay the real cost of completing and verifying fresh work for every credential, rather than minting aliases for free. An opal or saffron badge might show status, while a ripple of copied accounts gains no extra weight.
